
Command
    az network bastion create : Create the specified Bastion Host.

Arguments
    --name -n           [Required] : The name of the Bastion Host.
    --resource-group -g [Required] : Resource group name of the Bastion Host.
    --vnet-name         [Required] : Name or Resource ID of the Virtual Network. For all SKUs but
                                     Developer SKU, this virtual network must have a subnet called
                                     AzureBastionSubnet.
    --no-wait                      : Do not wait for the long-running operation to finish.  Allowed
                                     values: 0, 1, f, false, n, no, t, true, y, yes.
    --public-ip-address            : [Required for all SKUs but Developer SKU] Name or Resource ID
                                     of the Public IP. The SKU of the public IP must be Standard.
    --sku                          : The name of the sku of this Bastion Host.  Allowed values:
                                     Basic, Developer, Premium, Standard.  Default: Standard.

Global Policy Arguments
    --acquire-policy-token         : Acquiring an Azure Policy token automatically for this resource
                                     operation.
    --change-reference             : The related change reference ID for this resource operation.

Parameters Arguments
    --location -l                  : Resource location.
    --tags                         : Resource tags.  Support shorthand-syntax, json-file and yaml-
                                     file. Try "??" to show more.
    --zones                        : A list of availability zones denoting where the resource needs
                                     to come from.  Support shorthand-syntax, json-file and yaml-
                                     file. Try "??" to show more.

Properties Arguments
    --disable-copy-paste           : Enable/Disable Copy/Paste feature of the Bastion Host resource.
                                     Allowed values: 0, 1, f, false, n, no, t, true, y, yes.
    --enable-ip-connect            : Enable/Disable IP Connect feature of the Bastion Host resource.
                                     Allowed values: 0, 1, f, false, n, no, t, true, y, yes.
    --enable-tunneling             : Enable/Disable Tunneling feature of the Bastion Host resource.
                                     Allowed values: 0, 1, f, false, n, no, t, true, y, yes.
    --file-copy                    : Enable/Disable File Copy feature of the Bastion Host resource.
                                     Allowed values: 0, 1, f, false, n, no, t, true, y, yes.
    --kerberos                     : Enable/Disable Kerberos feature of the Bastion Host resource.
                                     Allowed values: 0, 1, f, false, n, no, t, true, y, yes.
    --network-acls-ips             : [Supported in Developer SKU only] Network ACLs IP rules. Space-
                                     separated list of IP addresses.
    --scale-units                  : The scale units for the Bastion Host resource.  Default: 2.
    --session-recording            : Enable/Disable Session Recording feature of the Bastion Host
                                     resource.  Allowed values: 0, 1, f, false, n, no, t, true, y,
                                     yes.
    --shareable-link               : Enable/Disable Shareable Link of the Bastion Host resource.
                                     Allowed values: 0, 1, f, false, n, no, t, true, y, yes.

Global Arguments
    --debug                        : Increase logging verbosity to show all debug logs.
    --help -h                      : Show this help message and exit.
    --only-show-errors             : Only show errors, suppressing warnings.
    --output -o                    : Output format.  Allowed values: json, jsonc, none, table, tsv,
                                     yaml, yamlc.  Default: json.
    --query                        : JMESPath query string. See http://jmespath.org/ for more
                                     information and examples.
    --subscription                 : Name or ID of subscription. You can configure the default
                                     subscription using `az account set -s NAME_OR_ID`.
    --verbose                      : Increase logging verbosity. Use --debug for full debug logs.

Examples
    Create a Azure Bastion host machine.
        az network bastion create --location westus2 --name MyBastionHost --public-ip-address
        MyPublicIpAddress --resource-group MyResourceGroup --vnet-name MyVnet

    Create Bastion Host With Zones
        az network bastion create --location westus2 --name MyBastionHost --public-ip-address
        MyPublicIpAddress --resource-group MyResourceGroup --vnet-name MyVnet --zones 1 2 3

    Create Bastion Host with Session Recording.
        az network bastion create --location westus2 --name MyBastionHost --public-ip-address
        MyPublicIpAddress --resource-group MyResourceGroup --vnet-name MyVnet --zones 1 2 3 --sku
        Premium --session-recording

    Create Developer SKU Bastion
        az network bastion create --name MyBastion --resource-group MyResourceGroup --sku Developer
        --vnet-name MyVnet

    Create Developer SKU Bastion with Network ACLs IP rules
        az network bastion create --name MyBastion --resource-group MyResourceGroup --sku Developer
        --vnet-name MyVnet --network-acls-ips "1.1.1.1/16 100.64.0.0/10"
